people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
translations.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
translations.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
translations.asv: And Jesus asked him, What is thy name? And he said, Legion; for many demons were entered into him.
